Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

So rule: every object moves vertically to nearest horizontal edge (top if closer to top, bottom if closer to bottom), keeping its column and vertical size, snapping flush to that edge.

def f(I, mode='ascbot'):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    objs=objs_of(I)
    sz=sorted((o['size'] for o in objs),reverse=True); k=len(objs)//2
    top=[o for o in objs if o['size']>=sz[k]]
    bot=[o for o in objs if o not in top]
    O=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # top: process highest originally first (descending minrow), slide up until blocked
    for o in sorted(top,key=lambda o:o['r0'],reverse=True):
        offs=o['rel']; r=0
        while r>0 and all(O[r-1+a][b]==0 for a,b in offs):
            r-=1
        for a,b in offs: O[r+a][b]=o['col']
    # bottom: process lowest originally first (ascending minrow), slide down until blocked/pinned
    for o in sorted(bot,key=lambda o:o['r0']):
        offs=o['rel']; r=H-o['h']
        while r<H-o['h']+o['h'] and False: pass
        # slide down: start from just above floor? no—start from its position relative: push down until blocked
        r=max(0,H-o['h'])  # default at floor
        # instead: compute how far it can go down given occupied cells; start assuming placed below only
        cellset={(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if O[a][b]}

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    objs=objs_of(I)
    top=[o for o in objs if border_hollow(o)]; bot=[o for o in objs if not border_hollow(o)]
    O=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    n=len(top+bot); pos=list(o['r0'] for o in top+bot)
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for j in range(n):
            o=(top+bot)[j]; cstart=o['minc']; offs=o['rel']; h=o['h']
            r=pos[j]
            # upward candidates: any cell above occupied? if no, and row>0 allowed
            blocked_above=any(O[r-1+a][cstart+b]!=0 for a,b in offs) if r>0 else True
            blocked_below=any(O[r+1+h+a][cstart+b]!=0 for a,b in offs) if r+h<H-1 else True
            moved=False
            if r>0 and not blocked_above:
                r-=1; moved=True
            elif r+h<H-1 and not blocked_below:
                r+=1; moved=True
            if moved:
                pos[j]=r; changed=True
    # clear occupied cells first then repopulate at final positions
    for a in range(H):
        for b in range(W): O[a][b]=0
    for j,o in enumerate(top+bot):
        r=pos[j]; cstart=o['minc']
        for a,b in o['rel']: O[r+a][cstart+b]=o['col']
    return O

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, deque
def solve(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(sum(g,[])).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=comps_of(g,bg)
    def free(o,dr,dc):
        for (r,c) in o:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or (nr,nc) in any_obj - {o}: return False
        return True
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for k,(c,o) in enumerate(objs):
            if len(o)<2: continue
            best=None
            for k2,(c2,o2) in enumerate(objs):
                if k2==k or len(o2)<2: continue
                d=min(abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1]) for a in o for b in o2)
                if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,k2,o2)
            if best is None: continue
            d,k2,targ=best
            cr=sum(p[0] for p in targ)/len(targ); cc=sum(p[1] for p in targ)/len(targ)
            myc=sum(p[0] for p in o)/len(o); myc2=sum(p[1] for p in o)/len(o)
            dr=int(np.sign(crc-myrc)) if False else int(np.sign(cr-myc)); dc=int(np.sign(cc-myc2))
            if dr==0 and dc==0: continue
            if free(o,dr,dc):
                for (r,cc_) in list(o): g[r][cc_]=bg
                o={(r+dr,cc_+dc) for r,cc_ in o}
                changed=True
    return g

for n in range(1,9):
    a=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; b=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    p=solve(a)
    print(n, p==b)
    if p!=b:
        pa=np.array(p); ba=np.array(b)
        print(' dims',pa.shape,'vs',ba.shape,'ndiff',(pa!=ba).sum())
        print([(i,j,int(pa[i,j]),int(ba[i,j])) for i in range(min(len(pa),len(ba))) for j in range(min(len(pa[0]),len(ba[0]))) if pa[i,j]!=ba[i,j]][:15])

import os,re,json,glob
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    G={}
    for f in glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        t=open(f).read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os,glob,re,collections,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
G={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl')):
    t=open(f).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        seg=t[m.end():]
        lines=[l.split() for l in seg.split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(l)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in l) for l in lines):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in l] for l in lines]
def fill_and_crop(gi,bg):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for i in range(1,H-1):
        for j in range(1,W-1):
            if gi[i][j]==bg:
                if gi[i-1][j]==gi[i+1][j]: out[i][j]=8
                elif gi[i][j-1]==gi[i][j+1]: out[i][j]=8
    # crop to bbox of non-bg in output
    pts=[(a,b) for a in range(len(out)) for b in range(len(out[0])) if out[a][b]!=bg]
    rmin,rmax=min(a for a,_ in pts),max(a for a,_ in pts)
    cmin,cmax=min(b for _,b in pts),max(b for _,b in pts)
    return [[out[i][j] for j in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for i in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
allok=True
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; gt=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=min(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c]) if False else None
    # bg guess: most common color that is NOT 0? Test both candidate bg rules
    bgc=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); alt=min([c for c in cnt if c!=bgc],key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    o=fill_and_crop(gi,bgc); ok_o=o==gt
    a=fill_and_crop(gi,alt); ok_a=a==gt
    print(n,'bg=',bgc,'-> match',ok_o,'alt bg alt -> match',ok_a)
    allok&=(ok_o or ok_a)
print('ALL',allok)

import os,glob,re,collections,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
G={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl')):
    t=open(f).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        seg=t[m.end():]
        lines=[l.split() for l in seg.split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(l)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in l) for l in lines):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in l] for l in lines]
def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    keepcols=[b for b in range(W) if any(gi[a][b]!=bg for a in range(H))]
    return [[gi[a][b] for b in keepcols] for a in range(H)]
allok=True
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; gt=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    o=solve(gi)
    d=[(a,b,o[a][b],gt[a][b]) for a in range(min(len(o),len(gt))) for b in range(min(len(o[0]),len(gt[0]))) if o[a][b]!=gt[a][b]]
    allok&=(not d); print(n,'OK' if not d else f'{len(d)} diffs {d[:8]}')
print('ALL',allok)

def solve(g):

                row=[x for x in g[i]]; colv=[g[k][j] for k in range(H)]
                seen=set()
                def hit(line):
                    # first non-bg, then ... any same-color on both sides anywhere in line
                    pass
                L=[x for x in row if x!=bg]; R=[x for x in reversed(row) if x!=bg]
                U=[x for x in colv if x!=bg]; D=[x for x in colv[::-1] if x!=bg]
                cL=L[0] if L else None; cR=R[0] if R else None
                cU=U[0] if U else None; cD=D[0] if D else None
                if cL==cR or cU==cD:
                    out[i][j]=8
    return out
